mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bbs_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_comment_id, id), id
SELECT * FROM bbs_comment WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_comment (post_id, parent_comment_id, author_id, anonymous_name, anonymous_pwd_hash, content, ip_address, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{authorId}, #{anonymousName}, #{anonymousPwdHash}, #{content}, #{ipAddress}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_comment SET content = #{content}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bbs_comment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
